description: Test suite for utility functions in the Mattermost project, including ID generation, time conversions, error handling, JSON parsing, and hashtag parsing.

methods.name: TestNewId
methods.description: Tests the NewId function for generating IDs of maximum length 26.

methods.name: TestRandomString
methods.description: Tests the NewRandomString function for correct length and character exclusion.

methods.name: TestGetMillisForTime
methods.description: Verifies conversion from time.Time to milliseconds.

methods.name: TestGetTimeForMillis
methods.description: Verifies conversion from milliseconds to time.Time.

methods.name: TestPadDateStringZeros
methods.description: Tests date string padding to ensure proper zero-padding.

methods.name: TestAppErrorRender
methods.description: Tests various rendering and wrapping behaviors of AppError.

methods.name: TestAppErrorSerialize
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of AppError, including error wrapping and wiping.

methods.name: TestCopyStringMap
methods.description: Tests copying of string maps to ensure deep copy.

methods.name: TestMapJson
methods.description: Tests JSON marshaling and unmarshaling of string maps.

methods.name: TestSortedArrayFromJSON
methods.description: Tests parsing of sorted string arrays from JSON, including duplicates.

methods.name: TestNonSortedArrayFromJSON
methods.description: Tests parsing of non-sorted string arrays from JSON, including duplicates.

methods.name: TestIsValidEmail
methods.description: Validates email address format correctness.

methods.name: TestEtag
methods.description: Tests Etag generation for non-empty output.

methods.name: TestStringArray_Equal
methods.description: Tests equality comparison of StringArray instances.

methods.name: TestParseHashtags
methods.description: Tests hashtag extraction and truncation logic from input strings.

methods.name: TestIsValidAlphaNum
methods.description: Validates alphanumeric and hyphen/underscore string formats.

methods.name: TestGetServerIPAddress
methods.description: Ensures local IP address can be retrieved.

methods.name: TestIsValidAlphaNumHyphenUnderscore
methods.description: Validates string formats with optional strictness.

methods.name: TestIsValidAlphaNumHyphenUnderscorePlus
methods.description: Validates string formats allowing plus signs.

methods.name: TestIsValidId
methods.description: Validates ID string format.

methods.name: TestNowhereNil
methods.description: Checks that various data structures are not nil or contain nils where disallowed.

methods.name: TestSanitizeUnicode
methods.description: Tests Unicode sanitization, including blocklist characters and allowed unicode.

methods.name: TestIsValidChannelIdentifier
methods.description: Validates channel identifier string rules.

methods.name: TestIsValidHTTPURL
methods.description: Validates HTTP/HTTPS URL formats.

methods.name: TestRemoveDuplicateStrings
methods.description: Removes duplicates from string slices.

methods.name: TestStructFromJSONLimited
methods.description: Tests JSON decoding into structs with size limits, including nested and empty structs.
